item.title: How I Finally Zoned My 35m² Flat Without Losing My Mind
item.description: If you live in a typical British flat—you know the ones, where the radiator is positioned right where the sofa should go, and you’re constantly playing a game of Tetris with your laundry airer—then you’ll get it. My place in South London is exactly 35m². It’s a lovely flat, honestly, but trying to squeeze a workspace, a lounge area, and a dining spot into one room is a bit of a nightmare.
